description: Fixed-fractional position sizing — a local calculation, not a data-provider lookup. Given account_size, risk_percent, entry and stop, returns position size in units, notional, implied leverage, stop distance, and — if a target is given — the reward:risk ratio. Direction (long/short) is inferred from the stop's side of entry. Deterministic: same inputs always give the same result.

risk_percent.description: Percent of the account to risk if the stop is hit, e.g. 1 for 1%

stop.description: Stop-loss price (below entry = long, above = short)

target.description: Optional take-profit price, used only to report reward:risk

name: risk_position_size

direction.description: long or short, inferred from the stop's side of entry

impliedLeverage.description: Notional / account equity as a multiple (3.5 = 3.5x)

rewardRiskRatio.description: Reward:risk ratio; omitted when no target was given

stopDistancePct.description: Stop distance from entry in percentage points

title: Position Sizing
